title: 12-bit LUT for `json_write_base64`
impact: Widens `json_write_base64`'s inner-loop lookup from 6 bits (four per triplet) to 12 bits (two per triplet), halving per-triplet loads/stores. Three order-flipped focused passes of `select_bytes_blob_base64.dart` reproduce -26 to -31% on the 4 KB blob lane and -17 to -31% on the 128 B lane; the 3 B tiny-cell guards stay flat (~-0.5 to -0.9%). ~1.3-1.5x faster BLOB base64 encoding for medium and large payloads at the cost of 8 KiB `.bss`.
